Fort Steuben appears in *Fallout 76*.

- A copy of the location named "Fort Michellé" exists in the game files, but it lacks any assigned cells or references.
- The development of the location was assigned to Dan Spedding.

1. ↑ Dan Spedding: *"One of the locations I had ownership of for the Burning Springs update for Fallout 76."*
